messages.subject: Pennington Industries / Tregarth Bearings - your letter before action of 28 October
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

We act for Tregarth Bearings Limited. We acknowledge your letter before action of 28 October. Our client denies liability. The bearings supplied conformed to the published TB-7208-HP data sheet, and your client's specification was not incorporated into the contract. Our client also considers that the failures are attributable to misapplication and operating conditions.

We are taking instructions and will respond more fully in due course, but you should not assume any admission.

Yours faithfully,
Geraint Tindale
Tindale Marsh LLP
